content.rendered:
Elementary conferences for Sherwood School District will be on May 2nd & 3rd. 

The students will not have school those days. Conference information will be sent home by each teacher.

Support our AG Library! The AG Book Fair will run the week of conferences from April 29th through May 3rd. The Book Fair hours are as follows:
Mon., April 29th & Tues., April 30th – 7:30 am – 8:30 am and 2:15 pm – 3:15 pm
Wed., May 1st – Golden Breakfast (Ticket holders only) – 6:45 am – 7:45 am.  After school hours:  2:15 pm – 3:15 pm
Thurs., May 2nd – 7:30 am – 3:30 pm & 5:30 pm – 8:00 pm
Friday, May 3rd – 7:30 am – 10:30 am
